test_title: PYST 10: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 10 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He ran _________ the field to catch the ball
solution:
The correct answer is, '**across'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Across** means **on the other end of something**.

 
 
• Example - ***Kevin walked across the room***.
 
 
 
• The correct sentence would be, **He ran across the field to catch the ball**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Over** means **being above something**.

 
 
• Example - ***Over the trees flew a hummingbird***.
 
 
 
• **Through** means **from one end to another**.
 
 
• Example - ***My dad took a hike through the woods***.
 
 
 
• **Besides** is used for adding more details.
 
 
• Example - ***I am not interested in it right now, besides, I hate it***.
